The '''Jungle Demon''' is a boss that can be encountered in the [[Nightmare Zone]]. It is a version of the regular [[Jungle Demon]] encountered in the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest.

It is vulnerable to [[demonbane]] attacks. The normal mode version will attack with melee and magic when in melee range like its quest variant, while the hard mode variant will only use its melee attack.

In Endurance mode, 7,744 reward points are earned upon defeating the normal difficulty version, and 24,398 reward points are earned upon defeating the hard difficulty version.
